description: Records that MUST be rejected by the schema, with the substring the rejection message has to contain. A validator that only ever sees valid input proves nothing; these pin down that required fields, formats, string lengths, numeric bounds, array bounds, and union members are all actually enforced. Matching on the message (not just on failure) stops a fixture from passing for an unrelated reason after a schema edit.

expectErrors.listing-bad-datetime.json: Record/createdAt must be an valid atproto datetime
expectErrors.listing-bad-shopref.json: Record/shopRef must be a valid at-uri
expectErrors.listing-currency-too-long.json: Record/price/currency must not be longer than 3 characters
expectErrors.listing-grouped-quantity-zero.json: Record/groupedItems/0/quantity can not be less than 1
expectErrors.shop-short-default-currency.json: Record/defaultCurrency must not be shorter than 3 characters
expectErrors.promotion-empty-targets.json: Record/targets must not have fewer than 1 elements
expectErrors.review-rating-out-of-range.json: Record/rating can not be greater than 5
